entries.reason: Docker Hub documents three response-less HEAD existence checks. The declarative operation model rejects HEAD for rest_read before dispatch, so the routes remain explicitly disabled rather than being misrepresented as JSON reads.
evidence: internal/connectors/engine/bundle.go:2676-2681 only admits GET and POST for rest_read; HEAD is rejected before any request.
internal/connectors/defs/dockerhub/sources/dockerhub-operation-crosswalk.json records the pinned OpenAPI HEAD method and absence of a response-body content contract.
entries.minimal_change: Add a typed bounded HEAD/status operation executor and a terminal command contract that is distinct from JSON direct-read output.
entries.recoverability: Enable after the bounded HEAD/status executor and connector-local terminal evidence are available.

entries.reason: Docker Hub source pagination is operation-scoped for the audit-log and SCIM-user collections, but direct-read pagination is currently read only from streams.json base.pagination.
entries.recoverability: Add a source-derived per-rest-operation PaginationSpec and have direct reads use it before deriving a command for these collections.

entries.reason: Docker Hub SCIM writes declare application/scim+json, while the typed direct-write executor supports only application/json and application/x-www-form-urlencoded.
entries.recoverability: Add a closed application/scim+json media-type branch to the typed executor, then retain the pinned request schemas and add non-live proof.

entries.reason: params-import reads operation parameters but does not merge OpenAPI path-item parameters; Docker Hub command parameter contracts retain the exact inherited parameters from the pinned document.
entries.recoverability: Merge path-item and operation parameters in params-import with operation-level overrides, then verify generated command flags against the pinned document.

entries.reason: Docker Hub credential-minting routes are live-safe only after secret-response handling and sensitive_policy live execution are implemented; their source contracts are declared but disabled as recoverable foundation gaps.

entries.minimal_change: Build the live secret-sensitive direct-write path and a typed secret-response contract that redacts output/logs/warehouse and routes returned credentials to OS keychain storage.
entries.recoverability: Enable after the bounded secret execution and response-redaction contracts, then add connector-local non-live proof.
